resources.string: Translation settings are incomplete: %1$s is missing.
Fill it in under Settings → Subtitle translation, then come back.
Authentication failed (HTTP %1$d).
The key may be wrong, expired, or from another region (Alibaba Cloud Bailian keys are tied to a region; using one across regions returns invalid_api_key).
Account balance or quota is used up (HTTP %1$d).
Top up in the provider console first; retrying only burns the remaining quota faster.
Too many requests (HTTP %1$d).
The provider asks for a %1$d second wait. Just retry afterwards.
Wait a moment and retry; if it keeps happening the provider is congested.
The provider rejected this request (HTTP %1$d).
Usually the model name does not exist, or that model does not accept this request shape.
The provider hit an internal error (HTTP %1$d).
This is not your configuration; retrying is fine. If it keeps happening, check the provider status page.
Cannot reach the provider.
The response shape is wrong (this is not a quota problem).
Retrying returns the same thing. Switch to a model that follows instructions better, or try another provider.

Alibaba Cloud Bailian (Qwen)

Bailian keys are bound to a region: using one across regions returns 401 invalid_api_key. If you enabled a workspace, the address becomes https://<WorkspaceId>.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1.
Official docs: api-docs.deepseek.com. The base URL is just the domain; /chat/completions is appended for you.
Zhipu GLM
The trailing /v4 in the base URL is required.
Kimi (Moonshot AI)
The official docs state thinking is **on by default**, so the disable parameter must always be sent, otherwise long subtitles burn a large amount of tokens for nothing.
Ollama (local)

On the emulator 10.0.2.2 points at the host machine. On a real device we recommend `adb reverse tcp:11434 tcp:11434` and then using http://localhost:11434/v1 — plain HTTP on the LAN is blocked by the system policy, only localhost / 10.0.2.2 are allowed.
Any value works for a local service; it can be left empty
Networks in mainland China usually need a proxy; you can point the base URL at your own relay.
Custom (any OpenAI-compatible service)
Anything that supports POST {baseUrl}/chat/completions works: OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, one-api relays, and more.
